response.quote_a: includes a child who has completed five years of age as on 1 st September of the year of admission.
response.quote_b: Children who complete six years by 1st June shall be admitted to Class I.
response.explanation: Document A allows admission for children who have completed five years of age by September 1st, whereas Document B requires children to have completed six years of age by June 1st to be admitted to Class I.
